author: The Infographics Show
description:
What came before the Big Bang? 

For decades, the simplest answer was nothing, but modern physics suggests the Big Bang may not have been the absolute beginning of space and time. The famous “singularity” appears when Einstein’s equations are pushed beyond where they can reliably describe reality. Quantum physics suggests that something very different may have happened at those extreme scales.
One possibility is cosmic inflation. A period of incredibly rapid expansion that happened before the hot Big Bang. Another is the Big Bounce, where our universe expanded from the remains of an earlier universe that had collapsed. Some models even suggest our universe could be one bubble inside a much larger multiverse.

We still don’t know what came before the Big Bang, but “nothing” is no longer the only answer.
